author: Lütken, 1859

note.en: A brittle star known here from two museum records. Disc size is an approximate field-guide value.
note.es: Una ofiura conocida aquí por dos registros de museo. El tamaño del disco es un valor aproximado de guías de campo.

evidence: GBIF: 2 records in the region (many are museum specimens)

sources.t: WoRMS: World Register of Marine Species, accepted name and range

recWhy: No mapped record between Gandoca and Cahuita in GBIF or OBIS[^2]; records exist elsewhere on the Caribbean coast of Costa Rica or in Bocas del Toro.

marks.en: Smooth-skinned brittle star with a dark brown to black body spotted or ringed with white; hides under stones.
marks.es: Ofiura de piel lisa, cuerpo pardo oscuro a negro con puntos o anillos blancos; se esconde bajo piedras.
